recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core FHIR. If Patient Care and Orders & Observations want CarePlan to reference the OO-incubator SupplyRequest definition across package boundaries, handle that as a new cross-package design/change request rather than replaying this R5-era core issue.
issue_request: FHIR-34477 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request, raised against R4 and applied for R5, asking to add SupplyRequest as a CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference targetProfile.
initial_application: Jira linked commit 7a6201070b574b69afe13a68407f9dcdee16be95, which added J#34477 to the CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference committee notes and added http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/SupplyRequest as a targetProfile.
additional_context: The current core build scope has changed since R5. source/fhir.ini keeps CarePlan active but no longer has an active supplyrequest=SupplyRequest resource entry. Commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed OO resources from active core configuration, removed the CarePlan SupplyRequest targetProfile, and updated current pages to point SupplyRequest readers to the HL7 OO incubator. The original Zulip thread also noted after Jira creation that SupplyRequest is not patient-specific, though the formal Jira decision still explains the R5 application.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding SupplyRequest to CarePlan in the current core source would reference a resource outside the active core build and would partially reverse the later OO-incubator migration.

related_jiras.note: Resolved-change-required issue for Jira Spec Artifact configuration for OO Additional Resources in the OO incubator; it supports the migration context but is not an Applied/Published CarePlan source change to decide here.
